en: Added Claude apps gateway support for newer Claude Desktop keys in `desktop` policy blocks, including `blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` and `disableBypassPermissionsMode`
zh: 新增 Claude 应用网关对 `desktop` 策略块中较新 Claude Desktop 密钥的支持，包括 `blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` 和 `disableBypassPermissionsMode`
